changelog: Account Creation supports both Accept all and regional OK privacy dialogs.
Startup recognizes the current step and up to five following steps through step 11, allowing optional prompts to be skipped when a valid later screen is visible.
Load Village is optional; its Cancel control is used only with the matching popup heading.
After step 11, the tutorial keeps its strict order. Startup controls retain fresh-screen, heading and gem safeguards.
Saved settings and licensing are preserved. Stop all bots and close MarineoClash before updating.
